description: Asks a USB-PD source for a voltage and a current, or reads its highest-voltage offer.

activation.text: Runs every pass while enabled: a request is sent on the first pass and whenever it changes, a reading on every pass.

variants.description: Asks the source for a voltage and a current.
Reads the highest-voltage offer of the source: its voltage in millivolts and its current in milliamps.

activation.text: Reads on every pass while enabled; gate it with a periodic block to read less often.
